verdict.rationale: Amazon Chime SDK is a managed real-time media service, so documentation of how its media layer scales across nodes or regions is a fair question. The pack has no such documentation: there is nothing on media regions, managed autoscaling, or multi-region distribution. The per-meeting limit of 25 videos and the automatic lower-bitrate subscription are capacity and bandwidth details, not documentation of how the media layer scales.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the vendor documents how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering
